meta.name: English
app.title: MikkiLens — Settings
tabs.label: Settings pages
status.heading: Status
status.listenNowHint: The same as pressing the hotkey.
status.stopStreamConfirm: Press again to stop the stream
status.engineUnreachable: The MikkiLens engine is not answering. {detail}
audio.heading: Audio
audio.outputHint: This is where MikkiLens speaks. Press Test to hear it.
audio.sampleText: Hello, this is what MikkiLens sounds like.
commands.heading: Commands
commands.hint: If a command is often misheard, add the misheard text as another phrase. That is the fastest fix.
connections.heading: Connections
youtube.hint: Press Connect and finish Google's page in your browser. You only do this once - after that MikkiLens remembers, and everything is voice-operated.
youtube.disabled: YouTube is switched off in the settings.
youtube.noClientSecret: This build has no sign-in of its own. Use an API key below, or save OAuth desktop credentials as data/client_secret.json.
youtube.opening: Opening Google's consent page in your browser…
youtube.openingAnnounce: Opening Google's consent page. Finish it in the browser.
youtube.keyHint: Or use an API key instead. No consent screen: enable "YouTube Data API v3" in Google Cloud, copy the key, and paste your channel or stream link below. That gives you the viewer count and the title; changing the title still needs the button above.
youtube.connectedWithKey: Connected with an API key. Viewer count and title work; changing the title needs you to sign in. Quota used {percent}%.
youtube.keyNeedsChannel: There is a key, but no channel to watch. Paste your channel or stream link below.
startup.label: Start MikkiLens when Windows starts
matcher.hint: MikkiLens matches what you say against the phrases in your command file. A downloaded language model lets it work out what you meant when none of them fit — where it would otherwise just say it did not know the command. Everything that already works stays instant; only the misses take a moment longer. It runs on this machine, and nothing you say is sent anywhere.
matcher.started: Download started. You can close this window; it keeps going.
matcher.cancelled: Download stopped. What has been fetched is kept.
matcher.readyWithVision: Ready, using {model}. It also describes your screen, so no vision model or API key is needed.
matcher.installedNotRunning: {model} is downloaded but not running yet.
matcher.notInstalled: No model downloaded. MikkiLens uses only the written phrases until you download one.
language.heading: Language
language.wakeHint: Raise it if it triggers while you are talking to chat.
log.heading: Log
log.hint: What MikkiLens heard and what it said. This page is the most useful one when a command is not working.
log.caption: History of what MikkiLens said
update.ready: MikkiLens {version} is ready to install. Open the menu and choose Install the update when you are not live.
update.readyPortable: MikkiLens {version} is available. This copy cannot update itself, so download the new one when you have a moment.
update.installing: Installing MikkiLens {version}. It will start again by itself.
update.notWhileLive: You are live, so the update will wait. Ask again after the stream.
update.portable: This copy cannot update itself. Download MikkiLens {version} to replace it.
